text: It's an empty bag.
Did someone lose this? Looks like it was dropped not long ago. Must have been this morning.
I wonder who it belongs to...
I figured it must belong to someone who traveled here this morning.
It belongs to the traveler I met earlier, in a different time cycle.
There's no bag here yet, but it will be here soon.
It has to be!
I wonder who it belongs to...
Hi there! It's nice to see a friendly face on this road.
Monsters everywhere, you know.
But I can handle myself. I have something special that keeps me safe.
Wear this cloak in {COLOR=BLUE}battle{COLOR=BLACK}, and you'll find that monsters will be somewhat less likely to attack you.
Here, you can have it. I have another one.
Oh, you already had one? That's great! I hope it serves you well.
Don't be shy, take it! I have a spare.
Pretty cool right? Take care on the road!
Nobody boards that ship without settling with me first.
The ferryman isn't sailing anyone across today, so I'm collecting his fares from here on.
A crossing costs five hundred gold, and the price doesn't move.

choices.text: *Draw your weapon rather than pay their toll.*

text: He had objections about the new fares, so he's making the crossing underneath us.
So it's your gold or your life, and I'd much rather it was your gold.

choices.text: *Draw your weapon and make them answer for the ferryman.*

text: Wise choice.
We cast off at 15:00, so keep to the pier until then.

choices.text: *Wait on the pier until she casts off.* [BLUE](Skip time)
*Step away and see to your own business first.*

text: Wrong answer.
Your fare is paid, so keep to the pier until we cast off at 15:00.

choices.text: *Wait on the pier until she casts off.* [BLUE](Skip time)
*Step away and see to your own business first.*

text: Dear traveler, if you'd like, I can put you to sleep among my healing flowers for 1 hour. Your wounds will mend while you rest. Would you like to accept this healing?

choices.text: *Politely decline her offer. Take your leave.*

text: Your health and energy are fully restored. Go with my blessings, traveler.
Dear traveler, if it was a bit earlier, I could have put you to sleep among my healing flowers. Your wounds would have mended while you rested.
But out here, it's hard to cultivate healing flowers, so these flowers lose their power in the evening.
If you come back some other time in the morning of afternoon, I would be happy to help you. I'm very sorry.
